# Your Daily Briefing – Friday 23 October

Yesterday was a tough one. With only 1.8 hours of sleep and just 3,682 steps, your body didn't get the rest or movement it needed — though burning 2,409 kcal shows your metabolism is ticking along nicely at 91.4kg.

That HRV of 60ms is the number demanding your attention today. It's sitting well below your 98–121ms baseline, which is your body clearly signalling stress and incomplete recovery. Don't push a hard session today — keep any movement light, think easy walking or gentle mobility work only.

Sleep is your priority tonight, full stop. Aim for 8 hours and protect it like a training session. On nutrition, hit your 175g protein target today — it supports recovery even on rest days — but avoid heavy meals within two hours of bed. Chester is 160 days away; patience today builds fitness tomorrow. 💪
